caption:
The banned-words list that makes AI writing sound human

Elevate. Unlock. Seamless. If your website copy sounds like everyone else's, these words are probably why.

Copy this:

"Rewrite this in plain, friendly English. Don't use: elevate, unlock, seamless, delve, game-changer, journey, tailored, cutting-edge, 'in today's world'. No exclamation marks. Short sentences. Text: [PASTE TEXT]"

On an invented cleaning company's tagline, "Elevate your home with our seamless, tailored cleaning journey" became "A home cleaning service that fits around how you live."

Tip: keep your list in a note on your phone and add it to the end of any prompt. Add the words you personally can't stand.
